point_density_bug.description: Extremely high vertex count on simple primitives (rectangles approximated by dozens of collinear points, circles approximated by 36-point polygons)
point_density_bug.impact: Increased JSON size, misleading sharp corner counts, false positive for drilling features

containment_blindness.description: All entities flattened, no parent-child hierarchy. Mother board not distinguished from internal cutouts.
containment_blindness.impact: CAM operation misassignment (e.g., cutting internal pockets with vibrate cutter instead of slot milling)

perpendicular_detection_failure.description: Zero perpendicular pairs detected even for fully orthogonal geometry (e.g., 1ks, fluenz_xl).
perpendicular_detection_failure.cause: Only intersecting perpendicular lines counted; non‑intersecting orthogonal pairs ignored.
perpendicular_detection_failure.impact: Geometric constraint features under‑reported for ML.

zone_detection_false_positive.description: Single‑entity zone detected in arbyd_vyrobni_data_v1 (uniform_pattern, 1 entity, spacing 0).
zone_detection_false_positive.impact: LLM misled into believing repeated pattern where none exists.

json_expansion.description: Full vertex storage and brute‑force proximity matrix cause excessive size (up to 7.2 MB for 78 entities).
json_expansion.impact: Context window overflow for LLMs, slow parsing.

core_principles: SNR trimming – remove information noise, not arbitrary size limits
Hierarchical topology – containment tree instead of flat list
Trigger‑based behavior – dynamic switching based on profile detection
Geometry simplification – RDP collinearity culling, preserve circles as CIRCLE

modules_to_remove.reason: Noise; LLM only needs aggregated vertex counts and segment statistics.
O(N²) combinatorial explosion, minimal semantic value.
Redundant with containment edges in entity_graph.
modules_to_remove.replacement: remove, keep only containment edges list

modules_to_remove.reason: O(N²) leads to 8 MB JSON for botanic_vse.

modules_to_add_or_enhance.name: collinearity_simplification
modules_to_add_or_enhance.effect: Reduces rectangle vertices from 58 → 4, approximates curves with fewer points.

modules_to_add_or_enhance.name: circle_preservation
modules_to_add_or_enhance.detection: DXF entity type CIRCLE or ARC
modules_to_add_or_enhance.effect: No vertex list, reduces JSON size by ~90% for circular features.

modules_to_add_or_enhance.name: containment_tree
modules_to_add_or_enhance.algorithm: Sort entities by area descending; if Bbox(A) fully contains Bbox(B), B is child of A.
modules_to_add_or_enhance.output: nesting_tree with mother_board_id and depth levels.
modules_to_add_or_enhance.benefit: Enables automatic CAM operation selection (outer_format vs slot_milling).

actions: separate ACI mapping for open paths

modules_to_add_or_enhance.name: perpendicular_detection_fix
modules_to_add_or_enhance.description: Count pairs of edges with perpendicular directions even if they do not intersect.
modules_to_add_or_enhance.implementation: For each shape group, compute edge direction vectors; count orthogonal direction pairs.

modules_to_add_or_enhance.name: min_feature_width_estimation
modules_to_add_or_enhance.algorithm: Find minimum distance between two non‑intersecting parallel edges within same parent.
modules_to_add_or_enhance.fallback: If not found, estimate from bounding box diagonal / 100.

modules_to_add_or_enhance.name: zone_detection_min_entities
modules_to_add_or_enhance.action: Discard zones with < 3 entities (eliminates false positive like arbyd_v1)
